description: Re-render an image with Rephrasy so it reads like an ordinary camera photo: a light diffusion pass with natural photographic texture. Subject, composition and resolution stay the same. Takes a local file or a URL (PNG, JPEG or WEBP, max 4 MB) and saves the result next to the original as <name>-humanized.<ext>. Costs 10 credits on "standard", 20 on "hq"; a failed image is refunded.

output_path.description: Where to save the result. Defaults to <name>-humanized.<ext> next to the input, or the working directory for a URL.

quality.description: "standard" usually finishes in under a minute; "hq" is higher fidelity and takes about 4 minutes.

url.description: Or: an http(s) link to the image.

name: humanize_image
title: Humanize image
